requirements: capture hashes implementation and test files
capture records stdout/stderr sha256 and return code
capture returns PASS on exit 0, FAIL otherwise, BLOCKED on timeout
verify re-runs the command and compares hashes

verify returns PARTIAL on any mismatch
sign produces an HMAC-SHA256 over canonical record content
verify_signature returns True only for the signing key
records persist to disk and reload identically
